title: The Hardest Lesson I've Learned As An Adult

scenes.narration: The hardest lesson I've learned as an adult is that life doesn't stop, even when you're hurt.
scenes.image_query: The hardest lesson I've learned as an adult is that life doesn't stop, even when you're hurt.

scenes.narration: No matter the pain, exhaustion, or loss, you still have to push through.
scenes.image_query: No matter the pain, exhaustion, or loss, you still have to push through.

scenes.narration: We grow up expecting happy endings, but find ourselves pretending to be okay instead.
scenes.image_query: We grow up expecting happy endings, but find ourselves pretending to be okay instead.

scenes.narration: Yet through it all, we find a strength we never knew we had.
